review_candidates.title: Senior Planning Engineer
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose The Planning Engineer is responsible for developing, monitoring, and updating project schedules to ensure that construction activities are completed within the approved time frame. The role involves coordinating with project teams, monitoring progress, identifying potential delays, and preparing reports to support effective project execution and decision-making. Key Accountabilities Develop detailed project schedules, baseline programs, and work plans in line with contractual requirements and project objectives. Prepare Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), activity sequencing, durations, milestones, and critical path analysis. Develop and maintain project schedules using Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project. Prepare construction schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities, as applicable. Review project drawings, specifications, BOQs, and contractual documents to establish realistic project timelines. Prepare short-term, medium-term, and long-term look-ahead schedules. Monitor actual project progress against the approved baseline schedule. Collect and verify progress data from site engineers, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders. Update project schedules regularly and analyze schedule variances. Identify critical activities, potential delays, and risks affecting project completion. Recommend corrective and recovery actions to mitigate delays and improve project performance. Monitor key project milestones and ensure timely reporting of deviations. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports. Develop progress curves, including planned versus actual progress and S-curves. Prepare manpower and equipment forecasts, resource histograms, and productivity reports where required. Prepare delay analysis, impact assessments, and recovery schedules when necessary. Maintain accurate planning records, schedule updates, and supporting documentation. Assist in preparing extension-of-time (EOT) submissions and time-impact analyses in coordination with the project controls and contracts teams. Qualifications, Experience, Knowledge & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 2-4 years of experience in project planning and scheduling within the construction industry; requirements may vary depending on project size and complexity. Proven experience in developing and updating construction schedules. Practical knowledge of Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project. Experience in progress monitoring, critical path analysis, and schedule variance reporting. Familiarity with construction methodologies, project documentation, and contractual requirements. Experience with building, infrastructure, or other relevant construction projects is preferred.

review_candidates.title: Project Director - Energy Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Job Description At GHD we are committed to addressing the world's biggest challenges in the areas of energy, water and communities. About Us We are a global network of multi-disciplinary professionals providing clients with integrated solutions through engineering, environmental, design and construction expertise. Our future-focused, innovative approaches connect and support communities around the world, building resiliency and sustainability for generations to come. Established in 1928, we remain wholly owned by our people. We are 12,000+ diverse and skilled individuals connected by over 200 offices, across five continents. Who are we looking for? GHD is seeking an experienced Project Director - Energy Infrastructure to lead the successful delivery of complex, multidisciplinary projects and programs while supporting growth across the evolving energy sector. This visible, client-facing role will support GHD's Energy business by providing senior project leadership across traditional energy, power delivery, and emerging energy infrastructure markets, with a particular focus on the Houston energy market. The successful candidate will be a commercially minded project and program leader with the ability to manage complex technical programs and portfolios, lead integrated delivery teams, maintain strong client relationships, support market growth, and provide disciplined oversight of scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, risk, and project performance. This role is focused on three strategic growth markets: Natural Gas, LNG & Pipeline Infrastructure: Supporting oil and gas, midstream, pipeline, gas processing, LNG, compression, and related infrastructure projects that enhance energy reliability and security. Power Delivery & Grid Infrastructure: Supporting substations, transmission, distribution, grid modernization, interconnection, reliability, and utility infrastructure projects for utilities, developers, and industrial clients. Energy Transition & Emerging Energy: Supporting BESS, gas-to-power, data center power infrastructure, electrification, renewable integration, and other energy transition initiatives. Working with an energetic and high performing team, this position offers a variety of duties and will see you involved in: Directing large, complex, multidisciplinary energy infrastructure projects and programs from pursuit through project completion. Establishing project governance, execution strategies, delivery plans, risk management frameworks, and project controls appropriate to project scale and complexity. Providing senior oversight of scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, commercial performance, and client satisfaction. Leading integrated teams across engineering, environmental, advisory, permitting, procurement, construction management, and digital disciplines. Serving as senior client-facing leader for energy developers, utilities, operators, transmission owners, infrastructure investors, industrial clients, and delivery partners. Partnering with Account Managers, Client Service Leaders, Sector Leaders, and regional leadership to support strategic account growth, cross-selling, capture planning, and client expansion opportunities. Collaborating across GHD's Energy Market, Oil and Gas Sector, and regional teams to connect delivery capabilities with growth opportunities across integrated energy, midstream, refining, petrochemical, LNG, power delivery, and energy transition clients. Supporting opportunity shaping, capture planning, proposal development, contract strategy, and client presentations for priority pursuits. Managing project risks, deviations, change management, client issues, and escalation pathways to support discipline, no-surprises delivery. Reviewing project performance, forecasts, commercial position, and recovery plans with Project Managers and business leadership. Mentoring Project Managers and technical leaders while helping build a culture of accountability, collaboration, health and safety, quality, and client service. Connecting clients with the broader capabilities of GHD across engineering, environmental, permitting, advisory, digital, Program Management, and Owner's Engineer services, including opportunities for higher-value advisory and delivery engagements. Maintaining continuity from business development through delivery by ensuring project commitments are understood, resourced, managed, and delivered successfully. Contributing market intelligence and practical delivery insight to support growth of GHD's Energy business in Houston and across North America. What you bring to the team: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Science, Business, or a related discipline. 10+ years of experience delivering major energy, utility, oil and gas, pipeline, industrial, or infrastructure projects, programs, or portfolios. Experience in one or more areas including oil and gas, pipelines, midstream, LNG, gas processing, gas-to-power, power generation, substations, transmission, distribution, grid modernization, BESS, data center energy infrastructure, or related programs. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, large capital programs, or portfolios involving multiple technical disciplines, stakeholders, delivery partners, and commercial considerations. Strong understanding of project controls, commercial management, contract administration, risk management, change management, and project governance. Experience serving in client-facing leadership roles such as Project Director, Senior Project Manager, Program Manager, Project Executive, Client Service Manager, Technical Advisor, or similar positions requiring both technical and commercial responsibility. Proven ability to build trusted relationships with client executives, engineering leaders, operations personnel, asset managers, project sponsors, and delivery partners. Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills. Demonstrated ability to work across multidisciplinary teams and connect clients with the broader capabilities of a global engineering and consulting organization. Self-motivated, visible in the Houston energy market, and recognized for professionalism, sound judgment, accountability, client service, and the ability to connect delivery excellence with market growth. Understanding of and commitment to GHD's values, Code of Conduct, risk and reputation management principles, and health and safety requirements. Preferred qualifications: Professional Engineer (PE) registration is considered an asset. PMP certification or equivalent project management credential is considered an asset. Experience delivering projects or programs under EPC, EPCM, Owner's Engineer, Program Management, design-build, or related delivery models. Experience supporting utility, energy developer, midstream, LNG, industrial, infrastructure, or data center clients. Familiarity with FERC, NERC, ERCOT, ISO/RTO, pipeline, utility, permitting, or energy market environments is preferred. LI-TW1 Hybrid Work : Our workplace thrives on a hybrid model, combining in-office collaboration and flexibility. Join us in the office, three days a week, to contribute, connect, and excel in our vibrant environment. The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in recruiting is just getting started and may be used during the process to improve efficiency and fairness. Your application may be reviewed by both AI and our hiring team. While AI supports some steps through the process, all final hiring decisions are made by humans As a diverse and inclusive organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of a diverse workforce. GHD is an equal opportunity employer. Upon request, GHD will provide reasonable accommodation for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process.
